bullets.text: **Netherlands** — €122.8/MWh wholesale (▼1.2% vs prior). Other hubs on the wire for comparison.
Wholesale prices are **easing** — still worth upgrading: lower consumption keeps bills down when tariffs rebound, and grants/finance are often time-limited.
Wholesale ≠ your restaurant bill — supplier tariffs, pass-through, and time-of-use still decide retail.
